title: Out
body:
This doesn't go on the disc,
he has no truths for you to believe in.
It only has the risk
destroy the fairy tale •
To all your fears of coming back
and what you couldn't stand to fight.

I have no voice, but I swear•
i have no water, but I thirst for mistakes.
Now I'm touching my body
and I'm looking for a child's passions.
But I always hide,
run and hide
in your arms, as you've taught me.
But I am in my world
and when I'm crushed,
i hide in the mind the depths.

Maybe love drowns me,
maybe your love will save me.
The vicious circle does not end
and your opinion surrounds me;
and I feel alone, neither side of me complements me;
and it's the inside that makes me angry.

This doesn't go on the disc,
now I'm starting to regret it.
Meaning I don't find anywhere;
willbe the reason I survive,
on a road unknown in the wrong tone.
What I became, what I loved,
this is where I was born, this is where I end.
